City of Chicago
                                                                   O2021-1003
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 3/24/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Tunney (44)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No.7-F at 662-664 W
                              Wellington Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                          ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO-
SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the RM-4.5,
Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-F In the
area bounded by:

       a line 128 feet north of and parallel to West Wellington Avenue; a line 150 feet west of
       and parallel to North Waterloo Court; West Wellington Avenue; and a line 225 feet west
       of and parallel to North Waterloo Court,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordmance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Addresses:
662-664 W. Wellington Ave.
